hero.badge: Dedicated to Every Child in Canada, Cameroon & Worldwide
hero.slogan: Every Child. Every Ability. Every Opportunity.
hero.description: Together, we build an inclusive world where every child and youth with disabilities has the opportunity to live, learn, and thrive globally through education, healthcare, assistive supports, and family empowerment.

transparent.title: Transparent
transparent.description: 100% financial and operational transparency in how donations and field supplies are allocated.

accountable.title: Accountable
accountable.description: We answer directly to our children, families, members, donors, and governing boards.

community.title: Community Driven
community.description: Culturally rooted, grassroots solutions tailored to the needs of local communities in Canada, Cameroon & Worldwide.

impact.title: Proven Impact
impact.description: Measurable, life-changing outcomes in education, rehabilitation, and family resilience.

aboutSpotlight.description: JOVIA Foundation is a registered humanitarian non-profit organization dedicated to improving the lives, health, dignity, and opportunities of children and youth with disabilities and their families across communities in Canada, Cameroon, and worldwide.

points.point1: Inclusive education and adaptive learning tools for every child
points.point2: Assistive devices, mobility carts & pediatric physical therapy
points.point3: Caregiver support, family respite & economic livelihood grants
points.point4: Disability rights advocacy, anti-stigma campaigns & inclusion

aboutSpotlight.cardText: Reaching underserved children with assistive equipment & adaptive schooling
aboutSpotlight.imageAlt: African Child with Disability Supported by JOVIA

programPillars.description: Delivering holistic, human rights-centered programs directly addressing the systemic barriers faced by children with disabilities across communities in Canada, Cameroon, and worldwide.

education.title: Child Development & Education
education.description: Adaptive education, accessible classrooms, communication tools, literacy supports, and scholarships.

health.title: Health & Mobility Supports
health.description: Wheelchairs, all-terrain mobility carts, pediatric physiotherapy, and specialized healthcare access.

family.title: Family Support & Empowerment
family.description: Caregiver peer support, respite programs, navigation resources, and livelihood micro-grants for mothers.

inclusion.title: Inclusion & Community Participation
inclusion.description: Inclusive recreation, social integration, accessibility education, and breaking disability stigma.

povertyRelief.title: Poverty Relief & Cameroon Centre
povertyRelief.description: Necessities of life assistance and the establishment of a dedicated rehabilitation & learning hub in Cameroon.

fieldInitiatives.description: Measurable, sustainable solutions designed to break isolation, open classroom doors, and build long-term independence for children with disabilities.

item1.title: Accessible Classrooms & Adaptive Learning
item1.description: Constructing accessible ramps, providing adaptive desks, speech devices, and teacher training to ensure children with disabilities thrive in mainstream schools.

item2.title: All-Terrain Mobility Carts & Therapy
item2.description: Distributing rugged mobility carts, customized pediatric wheelchairs, and delivering qualified pediatric physiotherapy in rural and urban communities.
item2.point1: Rugged hand-powered carts for unpaved terrain

item3.title: Caregiver Respite & Micro-Grants
item3.description: Supporting mothers and caregivers through peer respite groups, nutritional assistance, and livelihood micro-grants to ensure whole-family resilience.
item3.point2: Small business seed grants for mothers
item3.point3: Household nutritional and food security packs

fieldGallery.description: Every photograph reflects genuine field work: adaptive classrooms, wheelchair mobility freedom, caregiver support, and pediatric healthcare.

story1.title: Rural Disability Direct Aid
story1.description: Delivering vital supplies, assistive devices, and barrier-breaking support to remote villages.

story2.title: Mother Empowerment Respite
story2.description: Livelihood counseling and peer mental wellness groups for dedicated caregiver mothers.

story3.title: All-Terrain Cart Logistics
story3.description: Rugged carts engineered specifically for rough unpaved roads, giving children daily school access.

story4.title: Teacher Adaptive Training
story4.description: Equipping mainstream educators with skills to welcome and teach children of all abilities.

volunteerBanner.description: Join our dedicated volunteer network or apply for community membership to help shape inclusive programs for children across communities in Canada, Cameroon, and worldwide.

newsletter.heading: Join Our Circle of Hope & Inclusion
newsletter.description: Subscribe to receive quarterly impact updates, inspiring field stories, and governance reports from our global mission in Canada, Cameroon, and worldwide.
newsletter.confirmMessage: You will receive our latest reports and community news directly.
